about: Lucille A. Fontana is an attorney providing legal services covering Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff and Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Plaintiff.

Lucille Fontana, who practices law in White Plains, New York, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Pace University Law School. She graduated in 1981. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1982.
